description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R metric across various model scales in the LLaMA-2 family under different fine-tuning conditions. The horizontal axis contains the categories, ordered from left to right by increasing model size as LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B. The vertical value axis is labeled "CoLeG-R (%)" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at regular intervals of 10. Within each of the three model categories on the horizontal axis, there is a group of four vertical bars representing different training datasets, as indicated by an inset legend. The first bar in each group represents "no SFT" and is colored light blue with diagonal hatching. The second bar represents "+ SFT on $D_0$" and is light orange with horizontal hatching. The third bar represents "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$" and is light purple with vertical hatching. The fourth bar represents "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$" and is a solid light pink. Across the chart, the shortest bars are the "no SFT" and "+ SFT on $D_0$" conditions for LLaMA-2-7B, both at approximately 68%, while the tallest bars reach approximately 84% for the "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$" condition in LLaMA-2-13B and the "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$" and "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$" conditions in LLaMA-2-70B. The bars within each group are arranged sequentially from left to right according to the legend, utilizing distinct hatching patterns and colors for visual differentiation.
